initialGoalWalkthrough.method: Independent goal-only AI walkthrough of actual built frontend using visible labels, rendered accessibility tree, and screenshots. No application source, component names, tests, solution reports, or expected click paths inspected. Not a real novice-human test; no invented timings or satisfaction metrics.
